subheading: AI-native drug discovery, computational biology & longevity capital
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. kpis.label: Global biotech VC funding, strongest first half since 2022; ~76% from rounds over $100M, inflated in part by Isomorphic Labs' single $2.1B round

kpis.sub: GUARDANT SHIELD TESTS · SCREENING GUIDANCE RAISED TO $218-230M
kpis.label: FDA approved a higher-throughput, lower-COGS Shield workflow now live in production, and UnitedHealthcare's Shield coverage takes effect this month — the multiomics diagnostics layer keeps compounding while AI-native platforms swing on single catalysts
Insilico's AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor remains the field's furthest clinical milestone; zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval to date

kpis.sub: ARKG AUM · UP FROM $1.71B LAST WEEK
kpis.label: Still ~78% below the ~$9B 2021 peak, but the broad-based biotech rally keeps lifting assets — XBI now +86.6% and IBB +54.7% trailing 1-yr, both fresh highs for this cycle

themes.title: Guardant's fuller Q2 print is the multiomics thesis in one quarter
themes.description: Total Q2 revenue hit $335M (+44% YoY), Shield screening revenue surged more than 250% on roughly quadrupled test volume, oncology test volume grew 63% to ~104K, Shield gained American Cancer Society guideline inclusion plus live UnitedHealthcare coverage, and FY26 guidance was raised to $1.34-1.36B. Real reimbursed test volume compounding regardless of which drug-discovery platform wins.

themes.title: Tempus rallies on guidance while its patent case heads to a Markman hearing
themes.description: Tempus AI shares jumped roughly 10% around Aug 20 on raised FY26 revenue guidance (~$1.6B) and a second straight quarter of positive net income. Days later, a Markman hearing (Aug 27) in Guardant Health's patent suit against Tempus will start to answer whether AI-enabled diagnostic patents are even valid — a genuine overhang on an otherwise strong quarter.

themes.title: Intellia's HAELO data and CRISPR's cardiovascular readout both landed this cycle
themes.description: Intellia's Phase 3 HAELO trial showed an 87% reduction in monthly hereditary angioedema attacks, with a BLA expected in 2H26 and a possible launch in 1H27 — ARK added shares Aug 21 alongside Perceptive Capital Solutions. Separately, CRISPR Therapeutics' CTX310 posted 70-80% reductions in circulating ANGPTL3 at higher doses, extending in-vivo editing from rare disease toward mainstream cardiovascular risk factors.

themes.title: The 2026 IPO class is mostly working — just not for the two AI-native debutants on this page
themes.description: 13 biotech IPOs have raised $4.5B YTD at a median $302M, and most trade above their offer price. Generate Biomedicines and Eikon Therapeutics remain well below theirs, and about two-thirds of H1 2026 venture rounds went to biotechs that already had a drug in human testing — a reminder that capital is flowing selectively, not indiscriminately, back into the sector.

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: AlphaFold 3 lineage; Thrive Capital-led round adds MGX, Temasek, CapitalG & UK Sovereign AI Fund alongside Alphabet/GV. ISM8969 cleared FDA for human trials Jan 28, 2026 — the oncology candidate CEO Demis Hassabis says will anchor Isomorphic's first clinical trials by year-end 2026, a year later than his original 2025 target.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: Formally initiated the Phase III GENESIS-IPF trial for rentosertib on Jul 7, 2026 — 320 patients, 52 weeks, 47 centers across China; the Phase IIa data behind it (published in Nature Medicine) showed +98.4 mL forced vital capacity improvement at 12 weeks on the 60mg arm. Still the field's clearest clinical proof point; listed on HKEX (Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: Launched X-Cell, its first virtual cell model (4.9B parameters, trained on the X-Atlas/Pisces dataset), in March 2026. Built out its clinical leadership Jul 6 — Ci Chu to Chief Discovery Officer, Bo Wang to Chief AI Scientist, plus a new SVP of Translational Science & Early Clinical Development — a tell that it's moving from platform-building toward actually running trials.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: Epigenetic reprogramming for longevity (Founders Fund, Lilly Ventures, Jun 2026); moved its first candidate medicine into large-scale manufacturing in January and has since run four large-scale screens turning up dozens of new payloads that restore youthful gene expression and regenerative function in old human liver cells, still targeting clinical entry as early as 2027. Retro Biosciences ($1.8B valuation, $3B+ raised) has an Alzheimer's Phase 1 trial (RTR242, autophagy-targeting) underway in Australia with early safety data expected around August — CEO Joe Betts-LaCroix says the trial is going well with no dose-limiting toxicities so far.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval — rentosertib's Phase III initiation (Jul 7) is the field's furthest milestone, not a finish line. Recursion's Q2 revenue fell 60% YoY to $7.67M, missing estimates; management responded by cutting 2026 cash opex guidance to under $375M rather than promising a near-term revenue fix. Notably, the field's clearest recent clinical win — Intellia's HAELO data — comes from gene editing, not an AI-discovery platform.

bear_case.title: Catalyst-driven volatility
bear_case.description: These stocks trade on announcements; between catalysts they drift and dilute. Tempus AI jumped ~10% on Aug 20 guidance alone, while Eikon and Generate still sit well below their IPO prices with no clinical catalyst yet to offset the overhang — even though 13 biotech IPOs have raised $4.5B YTD at a median $302M and most of that broader 2026 cohort trades above offer. Single-name dispersion inside a strong tape is still real risk.

bear_case.title: Hardware and instrument risk isn't just a biology problem
bear_case.description: Quantum-Si's Aug 13 disclosure that Proteus won't launch until Q2 2027 — a full year late — alongside a 20% workforce cut, is a reminder that the proteomics layer's timelines slip just like clinical ones. Compare that to Abbott's ~$21B all-cash purchase of Exact Sciences: real test volumes and reimbursed CPT codes command real M&A premiums, while unproven instrument platforms carry genuine execution risk regardless of the underlying science.

bear_case.title: Funding is recovering, but selectively
bear_case.description: About two-thirds of H1 2026 venture rounds went to biotechs that already had a drug in human testing, leaving early-formation platforms — including some earlier-stage AI-native names not yet in this table — comparatively starved of capital even as headline VC totals hit a post-2022 high. Layer long-duration rate sensitivity on top and the funding window can close unevenly, favoring de-risked names over story stocks.

catalysts.title: Markman hearing: Guardant Health v. Tempus AI patent case
catalysts.description: The court will construe the disputed claim terms in Guardant's liquid-biopsy patent suit against Tempus — an early read on whether courts will treat AI-enabled diagnostic patents as valid subject matter at all, with implications well beyond these two companies.

catalysts.title: ARK adds Intellia (NTLA) and Perceptive Capital Solutions (FRNM) inside ARKG
catalysts.description: The buy follows Intellia's positive Phase 3 HAELO data for lonvo-z — an 87% reduction in monthly hereditary angioedema attacks — with BLA acceptance expected in 2H26 and a possible US launch in 1H27. Analysts remain split: TipRanks reiterates a $29 Buy while Morgan Stanley holds at Hold.

catalysts.title: Tempus AI (TEM) shares rally ~10% on raised FY26 guidance
catalysts.description: Management lifted full-year revenue guidance to roughly $1.6B and posted a second straight quarter of positive net income — a genuinely stronger data-network business getting priced for more perfection each week.

catalysts.title: ARK trims Illumina (ILMN) and 10x Genomics (TXG) while rotating into fintech infrastructure
catalysts.description: Across its funds ARK sold Illumina, Shopify, 10x Genomics and AMD while buying Cloudflare, Block and Securitize — a capital-allocation signal toward tokenization/stablecoin infrastructure, not a reversal on the multiomics thesis itself.

catalysts.title: ARKG AUM climbs to $1.98B; trailing 1-yr return to 105.9%
catalysts.description: Up from $1.71B and +72.7% a week ago as the sector-wide rally broadens — XBI now +86.6% and IBB +54.7% trailing 1-yr — a price effect across the whole space, not a rotation into genomics specifically.

catalysts.title: 13 biotech IPOs have raised $4.5B this year, median $302M
catalysts.description: Most of the 2026 biotech IPO class trades above its offer price, which makes Generate Biomedicines and Eikon Therapeutics — both still well below where they priced — the exception in this cohort rather than the rule.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: Eli Lilly
positions.note: Q2 revenue hit $23.0B (+48%) on Mounjaro and Zepbound, FY26 guidance raised to $85–87B; Verve Therapeutics (acquired 2025) is prioritizing the Heart-2 trial for VERVE-102, pushing in-vivo gene editing from rare disease toward mainstream cardiovascular — optionality stacked on top of cash flow that doesn't need it to work.

positions.name: Novartis
positions.note: Q2 sales +3% to $14.4B with guidance reaffirmed; deep AI partnerships across the pipeline (Isomorphic, Chai Discovery, Relation Therapeutics) are backed by pharma economics rather than a platform story.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: BioNeMo and the Lilly co-innovation lab (~7 months into build-out, now with an expanded model set covering RNA structure, molecular synthesis and toxicity prediction) make it the compute layer for nearly every AI-biotech platform on this page. It also sits in your AI, Robotics and Quantum sleeves — don't double-count the exposure across sleeves.

positions.name: Illumina
positions.note: Q2 revenue $1.16B (+9.5%) with FY26 outlook lifted to $4.60–4.64B; ARK trimmed its ILMN position across funds on Aug 18, but that's a portfolio-allocation call toward fintech infrastructure, not new information about the sequencing business, which still monetizes every experiment regardless of which drug-discovery platform wins.

positions.name: Schrödinger
positions.note: ARK bought SDGR twice in mid-August (combined ~$826K) while trimming 10x Genomics — a vote of confidence alongside Q2's ACV +27% and the new Bunsen agentic co-scientist; still the AI-native name with a real second business (software revenue) to fall back on.

positions.name: Recursion
positions.note: Q2 revenue fell 60% YoY to $7.67M, but net loss narrowed to $131.0M and cash opex guidance was cut to under $375M for cost discipline, while Genentech advanced the first neuroscience target into joint early discovery — the platform is proving targets faster than it's proving revenue.

positions.name: Relay Therapeutics
positions.note: Net loss widened 20% in Q2 and the company expanded its at-the-market equity facility from $250M to ~$463M the same day (Aug 6) — real dilution risk layered on the existing binary bet, though $910.9M cash and a concrete Phase 3 timeline (early 2027) keep the science genuine.

positions.name: Generate Biomedicines
positions.note: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target to $25 from $16 (Buy maintained) on Aug 6 despite a Q2 miss, and GB-0895's Phase 3 asthma recruitment is now complete across all six regions with Phase 1b COPD data still to come — third-party conviction is building faster than the loss is narrowing, though it remains an outlier below offer even as the broader 2026 IPO class trades above it.

positions.name: 908 Devices
positions.note: Q2 revenue +23% to $16.1M, adjusted EBITDA loss improved more than 50% YoY, $101.5M cash with no debt, and FY26 guidance raised to $68-70M on a new $6M ProtectIR order — the strongest print of any tooling name this quarter, still sized small because it's a single-digit-million-revenue business.

positions.name: Tempus AI
positions.note: Shares rallied ~10% around Aug 20 on raised FY26 revenue guidance (~$1.6B) and a second straight quarter of positive net income — a genuinely strong data-network business, but the Aug 27 Markman hearing in the Guardant patent suit is a real binary overhang, and the stock keeps getting priced for more perfection each week; wait for a better entry or a resolved case.

positions.name: Guardant Health
positions.note: Q2 revenue $335M (+44%), Shield revenue up over 250% on quadrupled test volume, ACS guideline inclusion, live UnitedHealthcare coverage, and FY26 guidance raised to $1.34-1.36B — genuinely excellent execution, but shares remain near a 52-week high after that run, so price still leads the story here.

positions.name: Intellia Therapeutics
positions.note: Phase 3 HAELO data showed an 87% reduction in monthly hereditary angioedema attacks, with BLA acceptance expected 2H26 and a possible US launch 1H27 — genuine clinical de-risking of in-vivo gene editing outside the AI-discovery names on this page, but analysts are split (TipRanks Buy at $29 vs. Morgan Stanley Hold) and ARK only started buying Aug 21, so the pricing debate isn't settled yet.

positions.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
positions.note: CTX310's Phase 1b data showed 70-80% reductions in circulating ANGPTL3 at higher doses, extending in-vivo gene editing from Casgevy's approved rare-disease indication toward mainstream cardiovascular risk factors — real optionality, but Casgevy's commercial ramp is still slow and the stock already carries a premium for this pipeline.

positions.name: Eikon Therapeutics
positions.note: Added Merck's Johnny Bennett, Ph.D. to its Scientific Advisory Board Aug 10 — a credible addition — but it doesn't resolve the Aug 4 lock-up overhang or the two board resignations that preceded it, and shares remain ~48% below the $18 IPO price with no near-term clinical catalyst.

positions.name: Quantum-Si
positions.note: Q2 revenue fell to $344K from $591K a year earlier, and the company delayed its Proteus commercial launch a full year to Q2 2027 while cutting headcount 20% to preserve cash — the least mature layer of the multiomics stack just got materially riskier, not more proven.
